evidence.observedFact: Skye Bar publicly markets private events spanning intimate dinners, celebrations, corporate gatherings, and full buyouts, with spaces for up to 30, 50, and 60 guests.
The private-events page directs prospects to plan an event through an inquiry flow or by calling 440-974-3572 and publishes info@skyebarmentor.com.
The active website lists current operating hours Monday through Saturday, a reserve-a-table call to action, and the Mentor address at 8434 Mentor Ave.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate an event-to-repeat-visit workflow that captures attendees or organizers with consent, issues a post-event comeback reward, and attributes subsequent visits.
Demonstrate automated acknowledgement and structured follow-up for private-event inquiries so phone and web leads enter one measurable follow-up path.

recommendedEntryOffer: Private Event Retention + Follow-Up Revenue Engine
notes: Observed facts show an active Mentor restaurant with multiple private-event formats and public inquiry/contact channels. The retention and follow-up gaps are sales hypotheses based on those public workflows; no monetary loss is claimed.
